messages:
lina: Quick design pass on the rules editor after the usability run: several people asked what the small legend chip 'Effective order' means vs. actual stack order. Also "Invalid order" still shows up for ambiguous conflicts. Screenshot + notes attached.

rob: I saw that too. Proposal: add a subtle legend bar above the list with two pills: 'Stack order' and 'Effective order (filters applied)'. When filters are active, highlight the second pill and show a small tooltip: 'Effective order shows how rules will evaluate after filters'.

anita: UX copy suggestions for the validation state: replace "Invalid order" with "Ordering blocked — unresolved dependencies" and add a secondary action 'Show dependencies'. Keep the toast focusable for keyboard users.

morgan: Accessibility: announce filter changes and which ordering mode is active using an aria-live region. For reorders, aria-live polite should say: 'Moved "Allow internal" to position 2 of 9. Undo available.' Also ensure disabled rules have an icon + label (not color only).

lina: Good. For visual clarity on long lists, let's switch to a narrow sticky left rail that shows priority numbers and a small state indicator (enabled/disabled) so numbers never shift during drag. That should help eyes find rank on first glance.

rob: On the preview side, prototype a compact before/after diff strip that only shows the affected rules rather than the whole list. Micro-animation: slide destination in place for 160ms. Respect prefers-reduced-motion. CSS I used: 
```css
.rule-item { transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.85,.2,1); }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .rule-item { transition: none; } }
```
This keeps it lightweight.

anita: Mobile note: compact mode should collapse metadata to a chevron. Provide a full reorder modal for phones to avoid long-press conflicts with swipe actions. In the modal, present the sticky index left and drag handles on the right.

morgan: Also add an undo snackbar that is keyboard-focusable and remains for 6s. Expose a Ctrl+Z scoped shortcut when the editor is focused. Add discoverability: small hint text 'Tip: press Z to undo' near the header.

lina: Nice. For auto-fallback rules the system inserts, show an inline banner in the preview: 'Fallback rule added: Default deny — Why?' The 'Why?' opens a diff and the suggested position; require user confirm before applying any auto-fix.

px-bot: Accessibility checklist: contrast for small disabled text must meet 4.5:1 or include an additional indicator. Drag handle must be a single tab stop with aria-label 'drag to reorder'. Live region should be polite and not interrupt other announcements.

rob: I'll update the Figma frames with the sticky rail, legend bar, and the compact mobile modal. Anita can you finalize the microcopy for the validation state and the banner? Morgan can prototype the undo/shortcut behavior.

deploy-bot: UX canary deployed: https://staging.redwood.com/routing/editor/legend-rail-canary

lina: Thanks team. Action items: Rob update frames by EOD, Anita post two microcopy variants here ('Ordering blocked — unresolved dependencies' and 'Conflict detected — view dependencies'), Morgan prototype keyboard undo and aria-live text. Quick 10m sync tomorrow 09:45 to review canary and pick final copy.
